disease_state.evidence: inferred: Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) are highly enriched in the nucleolar proteome but their physiological role in ribosome assembly remains poorly understood.

material_type.evidence: inferred: We show in Saccharomyces cerevisiae that the electrostatic properties of this lysine-rich IDR, the KKE/D domain, promote snoRNP accumulation in the vicinity of nascent rRNAs, facilitating their modification.
